steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 2 problems in 12 items
details: The Critic objected to the candid management verdict: the quoted sentences don't fully support it, so it looks overstated. Reason given: The quote describes a technical outcome of an incentive program rather than a business setback, mistake, or missed guidance.

The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation verdict: the quoted sentences don't fully support it, so it looks overstated. Reason given: The filing quantifies actions but lacks a stated policy or priority explaining how cash is allocated.

steps.title: Critic sent 2 findings back for repair
details: Candid management: constrained retry (the agent must cite something new or lower its verdict).
Rational capital allocation: constrained retry (the agent must cite something new or lower its verdict).
